subject: Pilot extension request — SDK rollout blocked by integration issue
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimblehealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot stalled — request for extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Elliot,

Quick update from our side — the SDK rollout for the triage workflow hit a hard stop this morning when our identity provider pushed a breaking change to the SSO token exchange. Engineering is tied up with the vendor and we don't have a confirmed ETA for a fix. Because of that our pilot timeline will slip by at least 3–4 weeks.

We still want to move forward with Redwood once this is resolved, but two asks to keep momentum:
- Can you extend the pilot window by 30 days?
- Can you provision an additional sandbox credit bucket (we estimate ~60k tokens) so our QA runs and end-to-end tests can continue once the SSO patch lands?

I've attached a short trace log that shows the token exchange failures (integration-error-logs.txt). Procurement may need a brief note from you confirming the extension so they can approve the budget change.

Appreciate any help — we really like the latency numbers and want to keep this on track.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Director, Platform Engineering
NimbleHealth

Attachment: integration-error-logs.txt (text)
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimblehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stalled — request for extension and sandbox top-up

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. Sorry to hear you hit that SSO disruption.

We can help here — two quick items from our side:
1) Extension: we can provision a 30-day pilot extension immediately on approval from my manager (cc'd Monica).
2) Sandbox credits: we can bump your sandbox allocation. Before I commit to the exact amount internally, can you confirm the token estimate you used (60k) reflects peak QA runs including full conversation seeds? If you can share a short test-plan bullet list I can fast-track approval.

If procurement needs a line from us I can provide an email confirming the extension and the temporary credits allocation (subject to final sign-off). I can also route this through our promotions team for a one-time make-good credit if you prefer that route.

On timing — if you expect the vendor fix in ~3 weeks, we should be conservative and ask for 45 days; if it's definitely 2 weeks we can do 30. Thoughts?

Elliot
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Elliot — thanks for the quick reply.

We had a sync with our infra team this morning. A few clarifications:
- The vendor says a patch is tentatively scheduled for 17 Mar, but procurement needs a buffer window to re-run security scans and sign off internal docs. Realistically we should plan for a 45-day window to avoid premature cutoffs.
- The 60k token estimate is our current guess based on full QA and two spike runs. If you can approve 75k tokens that gives us a comfortable margin.
- Procurement will want a short confirmation email that the extension is purely a pilot accommodation and doesn't change pricing terms for production. A line about access to audit logs and SOC2 artifacts would help them move faster.

I've attached a draft SOW we started (SOW-Draft-v2.pdf) — it's not final but shows scope. If you can confirm, we can get legal/procurement to draft a small amendment instead of a full re-quote.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis

NimbleHealth

Monica / Dev — quick summary and ask:

What they need (NimbleHealth):
- Pilot window extension (they're requesting 45 days given procurement/security buffer)
- Additional sandbox tokens (original ask 60k, now asking for 75k per Tom)
- Confirmation that we can provide SOC2/audit-log access for procurement review (we have a standard packet).

Why: identity provider broke SSO token exchange; vendor patch tentatively scheduled for 17 Mar but procurement needs extra runway.

My proposed response (fast approval path):
- Approve a 45-day extension to the pilot (start from current pilot end date).
- Grant a one-time sandbox top-up of 75,000 tokens as a promotional credit tied to DEAL-9834; credits expire at pilot end.
- Provide procurement with our SOC2 / audit-log packet and a short confirmation email stating this is a pilot accommodation and does not modify production pricing or SLAs.

Operational impact: will be taken from promotion budget and sandbox pool. Dev — can you confirm there are no gating technical constraints to increase their sandbox allocation today? Monica — please confirm if you sign off on the promo allocation and I will send the confirmation email to Tom/Sarah and sync legal if they ask for an amendment.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to run through the numbers.
